content.short: OpenZeppelin Upgrades provides plugins for Hardhat and Truffle to deploy upgradeable contracts.
content.description: OpenZeppelin Upgrades offers a suite of plugins for Hardhat and Truffle that streamline working with upgradeable Solidity contracts. The package is accompanied by thorough documentation that covers setup, configuration, management, deployment, and testing within the proxy-based upgradability framework. These tools reinforce established, secure patterns for upgradeable contracts and provide practical guidance to help developers implement, verify, and maintain upgrades across development, staging, and production environments.
